engine.note: `engine: 2` = current behaviour (what `new` writes); omitted = 1, the original behaviour, kept exactly for older videos.

standard.description: Short-form defaults: something happens within 1.5 s, no stretch of more than 1.5 s without a line, action, cut or sound; notes on 3+ static shots in a row and shots under 0.6 s.

intents.silence: long pauses are deliberate (dead-air notes are accepted)
intents.slow-open: the opening is deliberately slow (no-hook notes are accepted)
intents.offscreen: a subject's face leaves the frame on purpose
intents.back-of-head: seeing the back of a subject is deliberate
intents.abrupt: a sudden jump or jitter in motion is deliberate (a snap, a glitchy character)
intents.clipping: a body part passing through something is deliberate
intents.floating: a character is off the ground on purpose (hovering, flying)
intents.text-over-face: a caption or on-screen text covering a face is deliberate
intents.jump-cut: cutting between near-identical framings is deliberate
intents.cross-line: crossing the line of action between two characters is deliberate
intents.mid-word-cut: cutting in the middle of a spoken word is deliberate
intents.soft-focus: focus away from the subject (or on nothing visible) is deliberate
intents.static: a run of static shots is deliberate
intents.quick-cuts: very short shots are deliberate (a rapid montage)

notes.allow: `allow: [intent, ...]` on the episode or a shot marks a finding as deliberate: it is reported as accepted by intent, never hidden.
